steps.title: Excise and prepare gel slice
steps.instruction: Excise the DNA band from the agarose gel, trim excess agarose, transfer the slice to a 1.5 ml microfuge tube, weigh the slice, and keep exposure to UV light to a minimum.

steps.title: Add Monarch Buffer BY
steps.instruction: Add Monarch Buffer BY at 4 volumes per 1 volume of gel slice (e.g., 400 µl buffer per 100 µl ≈100 mg agarose). If the target DNA is larger than 10 kb, use 3 volumes of buffer instead of 4.

steps.title: Dissolve gel slice (incubate)
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37–55 °C (typically 50 °C) while vortexing periodically until the gel is completely dissolved (generally 5–10 min). With >2 % agarose or a lower temperature (37–45 °C), add 2–5 min to the dissolution time. For DNA >10 kb, after dissolution add an additional 1.5 volumes of water (e.g., 100 mg gel: 300 µl buffer + 150 µl water).

steps.title: Bind DNA to spin column
steps.instruction: Insert a Monarch Spin Column S1A into its collection tube, load the dissolved sample onto the column, spin for 1 min and discard the flow‑through. If the total volume exceeds 800 µl, load 800 µl, spin, then load the remaining volume and spin again; repeat as needed.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Wash the column twice with 200 µl Monarch Buffer WZ, spinning 1 min each time; discarding the flow‑through is optional.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µl Buffer WZ, spin 1 min, discard flow‑through (optional).
Repeat the wash with another 200 µl Buffer WZ, spin 1 min.

steps.title: Transfer column to clean tube
steps.instruction: Place the spin column into a clean 1.5 ml microfuge tube, ensuring the column tip does not touch any residual flow‑through; if uncertain, spin the column for an additional 1 min.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add 5–20 µl Monarch Buffer EY (or nuclease‑free water) to the center of the matrix, wait 1 min, then spin for 1 min to collect eluate. For DNA ≥10 kb, incubate the column with the elution buffer at room temperature for 5 min or pre‑heat the buffer to 50 °C to improve yield. Larger elution volumes increase yield but lower concentration.
